verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes an onboarding or application queue. Nothing shows ops users seeing why an application is pending, uploading or supplying additional documents, or a split between company-owned and bank-owned decisions. The only related item is a generic statement that the Dashboard and APIs give access to customer, compliance, and operational data. That is an adjacent capability, not the story itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can work the onboarding queue — see why an application is pending, supply additional documents, and understand which decisions are mine versus the bank's
